title: High-performance activated rice straw biochar: a sustainable triple-bottom-line adsorbent for removal of water pharmaceutical pollution
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24157-24173
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00965D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shimaa Rashad, Ahmed A. Farghali, Marwa Waseem A. Halmy, Hala Elkady, Nadia Badr, Ahmed Hassan, Heba A. Younes
Activated rice straw biochar was developed as a sustainable adsorbent for efficient removal of SMX and CLN from wastewater, while also improving overall water quality and supporting circular economy principles.
